purpose: Roadmap of externally published results; catalogue entries are NOT implemented reproductions

papers.title: Gaze Prediction as Time-Series Forecasting for Virtual Reality Applications: Quantifying Performance Variability and Extreme-Case Errors
papers.study_kind: Measured human gaze trajectories; no subjective visual quality ratings
required_datasets: Meta Quest Pro 90 Hz sample data (access check required)
replication_requirements: Same 40/44 ms forecast horizon
Subject-wise five-fold splits and no subject leakage
Correct binocular/optical coordinates and degree conventions
Match event segmentation, critical evaluation periods and statistical summaries
Reproduce LSTM/CTEF/ClPr or inspect official code first
Report reproduction gap with uncertainty

papers.title: FovVideoVDP: A Visible Difference Predictor for Wide Field-of-View Video
papers.study_kind: Human visual quality ratings and calibrated foveated video visible-difference modeling
replication_requirements: Recover legal access to paired stimulus/reference videos and human MOS/JOD ratings
Use official FovVideoVDP implementation and pin exact version
Match display resolution, field of view, ppd, luminance, EOTF and fixation coordinates
Reproduce rank correlation and JOD regression methodology
Compare our predictions against ratings without tuning on the test subjects

papers.title: XRBench: An Extended Reality (XR) Machine Learning Benchmark Suite for the Metaverse
papers.study_kind: Simulated real-time multi-model XR timing and energy scoring; NOT human subjective ratings
replication_requirements: Pin MAESTRO version and architecture assumptions
Reproduce official Figure 5/6 deterministic scenarios
Reproduce Figure 7 trends with repeated-seed statistics
Preserve energy/deadline/accuracy/frame-drop definitions
Only then compare compatible metrics against FoveaBench

papers.title: GazeBaseVR, a large-scale, longitudinal, binocular eye-tracking dataset collected in virtual reality
papers.study_kind: Empirical sensor dataset descriptor; NOT rendering perceptual judgements
replication_requirements: Download 2.3 GB primary recordings and retain license/provenance
Verify subject counts, task categories, sample times, eye-channel transformations
Validate predictions on entirely disjoint real participant IDs
Do not confuse matching recording counts with validating perceptual realism

papers.title: Foveated metamers behavioral experiments
papers.publication: Public perceptual experiment code and artifacts
papers.study_kind: Human psychophysical discrimination tests on metamerized images
replication_requirements: Identify exact peer-reviewed paper, archive and human test dataset
Match original stimulus geometries, viewing conditions and display calibration
Reproduce behavioral contrast/recognition threshold with official models
Map our image quality predictions to measured human results after data access
